title: Walking Safaris in Tanzania
excerpt: On foot, the bush feels very different. Where walking safaris are possible in Tanzania and what to expect.
body:
A walking safari makes you notice things you miss from a vehicle: tracks, dung, plants, insects and sounds.

## Where

- [Arusha National Park](/blog/arusha-national-park-guide/).
- [Nyerere](/blog/nyerere-national-park-guide/) and [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/).
- The Ngorongoro highlands.
- Private concessions near Tarangire and the Serengeti.
- [West Kilimanjaro](/blog/west-kilimanjaro-safari/).

## How it works

You walk with an armed ranger and a guide, usually in a small group. Walks last from one to several hours.

## Safety

Follow instructions, walk in a line, keep quiet and wear neutral colours.

## Minimum age

Usually a minimum age applies, often around 12 to 16.

## Who it suits

Travellers who want to learn more about the bush and enjoy being active.
